# Problem 2

loading libraries
```{r message = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
```



creating data frame

```{r message = FALSE}

study_df =
  tibble(
    files = list.files("data"),
    path = str_c("data/", files)
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    data = map(path, read_csv)
  ) |> unnest(data) |> 
  mutate(
    files = str_replace(files, ".csv", ""),
    arm = str_sub(files, 1, 3),
    subject_id = str_sub(files, 5, 6),
    arm = recode_values(arm, "con" ~ "control", "exp" ~ "experimental")) |>
  pivot_longer(
    week_1:week_8,
    names_to = "week",
    names_prefix = "week_",
    values_to = "observation"
  ) |> 
  mutate(week = as.numeric(week)) |> 
  select(arm, subject_id, week, observation)

```

spaghetti plot

```{r}

study_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = observation, group = subject_id, color = arm)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_path() +
  facet_grid(~arm) +
  labs(
    title = "Observations Over Time By Participant",
    x = "Week",
    y = "Observation",
    color = "Arm"
  )

```

From the spaghetti plot, it appears that subjects in the control group have 
have relatively stable observation values over time, while the observed 
outcome measure in the experimental group increases approximately linearly
over time from week 1 to week 8.
